svg.title: AFWAH
svg.desc: Afwah: a lone telephone pole on a dusk hill, four wires running to four distant clusters of lights, birds spreading out along the wires from the pole, the nearest burning ember orange, one pale blue bird on a wire gone dark. A Monte Carlo simulation of misinformation across four social networks.

g.text: A rumour is seeded on a few nodes and left to run through
four platforms with their own shapes and rules, a thousand
times over. Fact-checkers fight it. Sometimes it dies.
